prompt: Nowadays, young people are admiring media and sports stars, even though they often do not set a good example. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Nowadays, many young people admire media personalities and sports stars because of their fame, success, and luxurious lifestyles. However, many of these celebrities do not always behave responsibly. I believe this is a negative development because it can influence young people to adopt unhealthy values and behaviours.

One of the main reasons why this trend is harmful is that celebrities often become role models for teenagers. Young people tend to imitate the attitudes, fashion, and lifestyles of their favourite stars without considering whether these behaviours are appropriate. For example, when famous athletes or influencers are involved in scandals such as substance abuse, reckless driving, or offensive behaviour, some teenagers may see these actions as acceptable. As a result, they may develop poor habits and make irresponsible decisions.

Another concern is that excessive admiration for celebrities can lead young people to focus more on fame and wealth than on education and personal development. Many social media influencers present unrealistic lifestyles, making success appear easy and glamorous. Consequently, some young people may lose motivation to work hard or develop practical skills. Instead, they may spend excessive time following celebrities online rather than concentrating on their studies or future careers.

However, it is important to recognise that not all media and sports stars are negative role models. Many athletes actively promote discipline, teamwork, and perseverance. They also participate in charitable activities and inspire young people to achieve their goals through dedication and hard work. Therefore, the impact largely depends on which celebrities young people choose to admire.

In conclusion, although some celebrities have a positive influence, I believe that the growing admiration for media and sports stars who display irresponsible behaviour is a negative development. Parents and schools should encourage young people to choose role models who demonstrate good character as well as success.
